title: ヴィクトリアマイルにむけて

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Mom! Dad! I got to talk to City this morning! She wanted to know how my racing's going! Talk about a great start to the day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And yesterday, I talked to Mifuyu on the phone and she said that even though we're far apart, she'll always be with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I call motivation! With that, I knew I had to give this next race my all!
